paraphrase: From yoga comes knowledge and from knowledge yoga; yoga is twofold — of knowledge and of action; the yogin established in both never perishes.

checks.note: V. 23 is the twofold yoga (jñānayoga and karmayoga), and vv. 24-27 define karmayoga. The saying that knowledge comes from yoga and yoga from knowledge is earlier, at about v. 14 (jñānād yogaḥ …).

paraphrase: In the yoga of knowledge the limbs are redefined: yama is dispassion toward body and senses; niyama constant attachment to the supreme; āsana indifference to all things; prāṇāyāma knowing the world as unreal; pratyāhāra turning the mind inward; dhāraṇā motionless mind; dhyāna 'I am pure consciousness'; samādhi the forgetting of meditation.
